parsed.scene_description: An indoor retail space with a black ceiling featuring multiple rectangular fluorescent light fixtures and hanging decorative hot air balloons in blue/white, red, and yellow. A person wearing a white sweatshirt stands near stacked boxes of produce on the left. In the background, another individual is near a red refrigerated display unit. Shelves line the walls holding various packaged goods. The floor is reflective.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Individual wearing white sweatshirt with red text on front, dark pants, and glasses. Standing near stacked boxes of produce on the left side. Head visible above box tops.

objects.label: produce boxes
objects.observation: Stacked cardboard boxes in pink, green, blue, and white colors arranged on the floor. Some have printed text and images of fruit. Located near person.

objects.label: ceiling light fixture
objects.observation: Rectangular fluorescent light panel mounted to black ceiling. Bright white illumination. Multiple units spaced across ceiling plane.

objects.label: hanging decoration
objects.observation: Decorative hot air balloon shape suspended from ceiling. Blue and white striped pattern visible on one unit. Others are red or yellow.

objects.label: refrigerated display unit
objects.observation: Tall red and white refrigerated case with glass front. Located in background right area. Contains items inside.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Individual wearing dark jacket and pants standing near red refrigerated unit in background. Facing away from camera.

objects.label: shelf
objects.observation: Metal shelving unit on left side holding various packaged goods. White wire baskets visible on upper shelves.

objects.label: produce display bin
objects.observation: Wooden or plastic bin filled with red and yellow produce items. Located in center foreground area.
